items.t: Coca-Cola (KO) Hands 75% Of Its African Bottler To A Bigger Franchise Partner
items.sum: Coca-Cola (NYSE:KO) announced that Coca-Cola HBC will acquire a 75% stake in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa, creating a larger bottling group. The deal makes Coca-Cola HBC the second-largest Coca-Cola bottler globally by volume and geographic reach across Europe and Africa.
